Bug_Title: "super.finalize()" should be called at the end of "Object.finalize()" implementations
Bug_Explanation: The bug is that'super.finalize()' is not called at the end of 'Object.finalize()' implementation as recommended for proper resource disposal. This can lead to issues if the parent class also needs to dispose of some resources.
